body: For task1612-transport-doer: coordination/native launcher can export AIDA_BIN pointing to canonical coordinator. Root observed AIDA_BIN=/home/joe/ai/aida/target/agent. BUG1807 full workspace has concrete test-harness contamination: aida_exe_path prefers it, BUG1682 subprocess tests run normal CLI with --exact, BUG1749 expects its own deps test runner and refuses an ambient redirect. Before this transport slice test commands, inspect and remove ambient coordinating AIDA_BIN from TEST subprocess environments so tests use their own executable, while retaining fake HOME/live-home fences and normal Cargo slots. Use absolute target/agent/aida for actual canonical coordination as before. Do not modify production resolver or call this an authority bypass. Source-grounded test isolation prevents known false failures; report any residual genuine failure normally.
subject: Preserve own test runner: isolate ambient coordinating AIDA_BIN
